english: ReviewRemoval is the service brand on reviewremoval.ca. “We”, “us” and “our” mean the supplier identified in your written order confirmation. Before any payment, your written order must identify the legal supplier, its business contact details and the services purchased. These terms cover the website, enquiries and any paid order that incorporates them. Our services are intended for businesses and their authorized representatives; describing that intended audience does not remove rights that apply by law.

By deliberately submitting a request after the linked notice, you agree to these terms for the enquiry and acknowledge the Privacy Policy. You can read, save or print them before submitting. If you do not agree, do not submit. An enquiry is free: it is not a payment authorization, an accepted removal order or a promise that we will take the case.

A paid service begins only after we accept the scope and you approve the written order, price and payment terms. The order must identify the review URLs or an agreed method of selecting them, the work included, fees, taxes, any timing estimate, the success test and cancellation terms. You must have legal capacity and authority to bind the business. An expressly agreed order-specific term prevails only for that order; mandatory law always prevails. A later invoice cannot impose new terms without your agreement.
3. No guarantee of removal or business results

Successful removal is not guaranteed. We offer assessment, preparation, reporting assistance and agreed follow-up, not control of a platform or the sale of a deletion. Google, Meta/Facebook, Yelp, Tripadvisor, Trustpilot, Glassdoor, Booking.com, Indeed and other platforms make their own decisions. We are independent and are not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

A review may be refused for removal, remain visible, disappear temporarily, return, be edited or be reposted. No particular processing time, appeal decision, permanent absence, rating increase, search position, revenue, customer response or reputational improvement is promised. Any stated timeline, including “1–2 weeks”, is an estimate, not a deadline or warranty. A success-based fee is a billing condition, not a guarantee that success will occur.

We use the public profile, review links and factual context you provide to assess a concern and carry out the work in the accepted order. You authorize only those agreed steps and the use of relevant information with the applicable platform to perform them. We do not have permission to alter your business profile, post a public reply, contact a reviewer or make another material account change unless separately authorized. Some steps may require you to act through your own account. Do not send passwords or authentication codes.

We do not provide legal representation, decide whether content is legally defamatory or undertake litigation, legal demands or regulatory complaints. Consult your own lawyer for those matters. We may decline unlawful, abusive, unsupported or policy-inconsistent requests; you must not ask us to fabricate facts, impersonate someone, misuse reporting tools or suppress legitimate feedback through deception.

You are responsible for your business, accounts, products, services, public statements and relationships with customers, employees and reviewers. Provide accurate, current information and material you may lawfully share; identify uncertainty rather than present it as fact. Redact irrelevant personal information. An unfamiliar name or an unfavourable opinion alone does not establish that a review is false.

Check review selection and factual drafts when we request approval, respond to reasonable information requests and tell us about parallel reports, decisions, account restrictions or changes to the review. You retain responsibility for your own account security and actions. Delays caused by missing information or access can delay the agreed work. We are responsible for our own obligations under the accepted order and applicable law.

Our published review-removal pricing is CAD $50 upfront per accepted review and CAD $125 for each successfully removed review. Other reputation services require a separate written scope and quote. Prices are in Canadian dollars. Applicable taxes and any separately approved expenses must be disclosed before ordering; no additional work or recurring subscription is authorized by the enquiry form.

The upfront fee pays for the agreed assessment, preparation and management work, not a guaranteed result. Failure to obtain removal alone does not create a refund entitlement for work properly performed, subject to the cancellation rules below, the accepted order and mandatory law. No success fee applies to an identified review that has not met the agreed removal test. Mixed outcomes are billed per review.

Before payment, agree how removal will be checked, the observation or confirmation point and the evidence you receive. A temporary display issue, a changed rating or removal of a different review does not by itself satisfy that test. Without an agreed success test, we must agree one before invoicing a success fee. If the same review later returns, there is no automatic second success fee. Continued monitoring, additional reporting, replacement work and any return-related refund must be expressly included in the order; no permanent-removal warranty is implied.

To cancel, contact us promptly with your business name, email and order reference. Before any paid work begins, you may cancel for a refund of an advance payment for unperformed work. After authorized work starts, we may retain only fees reasonably earned for work actually performed and separately approved, non-recoverable expenses, subject to the accepted order and applicable law; we will explain the calculation and refund any unearned balance. There is no blanket forfeiture of all payments.

If we decline the case or stop work, the same unearned-balance rule applies. An incurred success fee remains subject to its agreed test. Tell us about incomplete work, a duplicate charge or an unauthorized charge so we can investigate; this does not restrict a lawful chargeback, complaint, cancellation or other remedy, or require you to contact us before exercising a mandatory right. Refunds due are returned to the original payment method where reasonably possible and within any legally required period. No term removes a remedy for our failure to deliver agreed services.
8. Third-party decisions and events outside our control

Platforms and reviewers can change policies, restrict accounts, alter visibility, restore content or publish responses independently of us. We do not assume responsibility for a third party’s independent act, your pre-existing review or dispute, the truth of your statements, or your own account or business conduct. These are limits on the work we undertake, not a release for our own breach or wrongdoing.

Interruptions outside reasonable control, such as platform outages or policy changes, may delay performance. We will communicate a material interruption and available next steps; prepaid unperformed work remains subject to section 7. Nothing here authorizes inaccurate reporting or promises that a platform will not act on information it receives.

This section applies only to the extent permitted by applicable law. For a business transaction where these limits are lawful, we are not liable for indirect, incidental, consequential, special, exemplary or punitive loss, or lost profit, revenue, opportunity, goodwill, anticipated savings or data, arising from use of the website or the service, including an unsuccessful, delayed or reversed removal, whether the claim is framed in contract, tort (including ordinary negligence) or otherwise, even if such loss was foreseeable.

For claims to which a contractual cap may lawfully apply, our total aggregate liability arising from the affected order is limited to the greater of CAD $100 and the fees you actually paid us for that order. For a free enquiry or website use without an order, that cap is CAD $100. This does not limit refunds of unearned fees required under section 7.

These exclusions and caps do not apply to fraud, wilful misconduct, gross negligence, intentional or gross fault, bodily or moral injury where protected by law, or any liability, warranty, privacy obligation or remedy that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited. In particular, no exclusion applies where consumer law prohibits a merchant from excluding responsibility for its own acts. Mandatory rights prevail over every other part of these terms. We do not promise immunity from claims, and you do not waive a statutory claim, court access, regulator complaint or other non-waivable right.
10. Claims caused by unlawful client material

Only for a business transaction and where lawful, you will reimburse reasonable, documented third-party claim losses and legal costs to the extent caused by your knowingly false or unlawfully supplied material, lack of authority to act, or unlawful instructions. This obligation does not cover our breach, negligence or other wrongdoing, or a platform’s independent decision; responsibility is allocated according to each party’s contribution. We must promptly notify you, reasonably cooperate in a defence and not agree to a settlement binding you without your written consent. This does not prevent you from disputing responsibility or exercising a protected right.

Articles, statistics, graphs, checklists and calculators are general information, not legal or financial advice or a prediction for a particular case. Source data, rounding and stated assumptions limit their interpretation. Website access is provided as available, with no promise of uninterrupted or error-free operation to the extent the law permits. Links and platform marks do not imply endorsement.

We retain rights in original website material, subject to third-party rights and any published licence. Research and figures explicitly released under CC BY 4.0 remain reusable under that licence; these terms do not revoke it. You retain rights in your submitted material and grant only the permission reasonably necessary to assess and perform your requested service, not permission for public advertising or testimonials.

Please contact us with your concerns. We will seek a practical resolution. No mandatory arbitration or class-action waiver is imposed. Subject to mandatory law, the law of Ontario and applicable federal Canadian law governs; this choice does not displace protections, language rights or a court venue you are entitled to under the law that applies to you. A consumer is not required to bring a claim outside a legally protected home jurisdiction.

If a provision is unenforceable, it is ineffective only to the extent necessary; the remaining lawful terms continue. Updates are dated and apply to future enquiries or orders. The version accepted for an existing order remains applicable unless both sides agree to a lawful change. We do not use website updates to change an accepted price, remove an accrued right or impose retroactive obligations. Keep your order, these terms and the correspondence. Version 2026-10-27.

Un service payant commence uniquement après notre acceptation de sa portée et votre approbation de la commande écrite, du prix et des modalités de paiement. 3. Aucune garantie de suppression ni de résultat commercial

Google, Meta/Facebook, Yelp, Tripadvisor, Trustpilot, Glassdoor, Booking.com, Indeed et les autres plateformes prennent leurs propres décisions. Nous sommes indépendants, sans affiliation ni approbation de leur part.

Un avis peut rester en ligne, disparaître temporairement, être rétabli, modifié ou republié. Aucun délai, résultat d’appel, retrait permanent, hausse de note, classement, revenu, comportement de clientèle ou amélioration de réputation n’est promis. Tout délai annoncé, y compris « 1 à 2 semaines », est une estimation et non une échéance garantie. Les frais de réussite sont une condition de facturation, pas une garantie de résultat.

Vous autorisez uniquement les étapes convenues et l’utilisation des renseignements pertinents auprès de la plateforme pour les réaliser. Nous n’avons pas l’autorisation de modifier votre fiche, publier une réponse, contacter un auteur ou modifier matériellement un compte sans autorisation distincte. Certaines étapes nécessitent votre intervention dans votre compte. Ne transmettez aucun mot de passe ni code d’authentification.

Nous ne fournissons pas de représentation juridique, d’avis sur le caractère diffamatoire d’un contenu, de mise en demeure ni de procédure judiciaire ou réglementaire. Consultez votre propre juriste. Nous pouvons refuser une demande illégale, abusive, non étayée ou incompatible avec les règles. Il est interdit de demander des faits inventés, une usurpation d’identité, un signalement trompeur ou la suppression de commentaires légitimes par tromperie.

Vous demeurez responsable de votre entreprise, de vos comptes, services, produits, déclarations et relations avec la clientèle, le personnel et les auteurs d’avis. Fournissez des renseignements exacts et actuels que vous pouvez légalement partager, précisez les incertitudes et masquez les données personnelles inutiles. Un nom inconnu ou une opinion défavorable ne prouve pas à lui seul qu’un avis est faux.

Vérifiez la sélection des avis et les projets factuels soumis à votre approbation; répondez aux demandes raisonnables et signalez les démarches parallèles, décisions et changements pertinents. Vous gérez la sécurité de vos comptes et vos propres actions. Des renseignements ou accès manquants peuvent retarder le travail. Tarifs publiés : 50 $ CA de frais initiaux par avis accepté et 125 $ CA par avis supprimé avec succès. Les autres services de réputation nécessitent un devis distinct. Les frais initiaux rémunèrent le travail convenu d’évaluation, de préparation et de gestion, sans garantir de résultat. L’absence de suppression ne justifie pas à elle seule le remboursement du travail correctement exécuté, sous réserve de la commande, de l’article 7 et du droit impératif. Aucun frais de réussite ne s’applique à un avis qui ne satisfait pas au critère convenu. Les résultats partiels sont facturés par avis.

Avant paiement, convenez du mode de vérification, du moment d’observation ou de confirmation et de la preuve fournie. Un problème d’affichage, une variation de note ou la suppression d’un autre avis ne suffit pas. Sans critère convenu, il faut en convenir avant toute facture de réussite. Le retour du même avis ne déclenche pas automatiquement de nouveaux frais de réussite. Le suivi continu, les nouvelles démarches, un remplacement ou un remboursement lié au retour doivent être expressément prévus; aucune permanence n’est garantie.

Pour annuler, veuillez nous contacter rapidement avec le nom de l’entreprise, le courriel et la référence. Avant le début du travail payant, une avance pour du travail non exécuté est remboursable. Signalez un travail incomplet ou un paiement en double ou non autorisé; cela ne limite aucun droit légal de contestation, de rétrofacturation, d’annulation ou de recours et n’impose aucune démarche préalable à l’exercice d’un droit impératif. Une plateforme ou un auteur peut modifier ses règles, restreindre un compte, changer la visibilité, rétablir un avis ou publier une réponse indépendamment de nous. Un événement hors de notre contrôle raisonnable peut retarder le travail. Nous communiquerons toute interruption importante et les suites possibles; les avances relatives au travail non exécuté demeurent soumises à l’article 7. Rien n’autorise un signalement inexact ni ne garantit l’absence de réaction d’une plateforme.

Ces limites s’appliquent uniquement dans la mesure permise par la loi. Pour les réclamations pouvant légalement être plafonnées, notre responsabilité totale pour la commande concernée est limitée au plus élevé de 100 $ CA ou des frais que vous nous avez effectivement payés pour cette commande. Vous ne renoncez à aucun recours légal protégé, accès au tribunal, plainte auprès d’un organisme ou autre droit auquel il est interdit de renoncer.
10. Réclamations causées par du matériel illicite

english:
ReviewRemoval uses the information you submit to assess the requested service, prepare a quote, reply, perform an accepted order, handle cancellations and maintain necessary business records. Forms collect your name, business and contact details, public profile and review URLs, selected service, review count and any notes you provide. We also record the terms version, notice text, policy links, submission page, language and a client-device submission time. The receiving service records a server timestamp. This records the submission context; it does not prove that you read a document.

Send only information you are entitled to share. Do not include passwords, authentication codes, card numbers, medical records, government identifiers or unrelated customer or employee records. We do not need that information for a public-review assessment.

Forms transmit information to Google Apps Script for processing in Google Sheets and email notifications. We use it to reply and administer the request. Material relevant to a paid order may be shared with the review platform as needed to perform authorized reporting; approval of a request is not permission to make your private material public. We may disclose information when required by law or reasonably necessary to protect legal rights, with applicable safeguards.

Hosting, network, email and Google service providers may process information outside your province or Canada. Their infrastructure can process IP addresses, requested pages, browser and device details and security logs. External links have their own privacy practices. We do not sell enquiry data or treat a service request as consent to unrelated marketing.

This site loads the Google Ads tag AW-18449308865. Depending on browser settings and applicable consent choices, Google may process device identifiers, IP and page or event information and use cookies for advertising measurement. Form text, email addresses and review evidence must not be sent to the tag by our form code. You can manage cookies in your browser and advertising choices through Google My Ad Center. See Google’s partner-site data explanation. Our forms can be submitted without enabling advertising tracking.

We keep request and service records only for as long as reasonably needed for the purpose collected, accepted orders, legal accounting obligations and the establishment or defence of legal claims. Data no longer needed should be deleted or de-identified; there is no promise of indefinite storage or automatic immediate deletion. Access is limited to people and providers who need it for those purposes. We use reasonable safeguards, but no internet or email service can promise perfect security.

You may ask about our practices, seek access to or correction of your information, request deletion where applicable, withdraw consent subject to legal and contractual limits, or make a privacy complaint through our contact form: contact us. Explain the request without sending sensitive identification through a general form. We may reasonably verify identity. Withdrawing information needed for the service may prevent further work; legal retention and mandatory privacy rights still apply. We will respond within applicable legal deadlines. You may also contact the privacy regulator with jurisdiction.

This policy is effective October 27, 2026. Material new purposes or disclosures require appropriate notice and consent where required; a policy update is not retroactive permission. The legal service supplier and business contact details must be given in your written order before payment. For privacy enquiries, contact us. This notice is separate from any optional marketing choice.

Les formulaires transmettent les données à Google Apps Script pour leur traitement dans Google Sheets et les notifications par courriel. Les éléments pertinents peuvent être communiqués à la plateforme d’avis pour les démarches autorisées d’une commande payante; cela n’autorise pas la publication de vos documents privés. Une communication peut être nécessaire en vertu de la loi ou pour protéger des droits, avec les garanties applicables. Ce site charge la balise Google Ads AW-18449308865. Selon les réglages du navigateur et les choix de consentement applicables, Google peut traiter les identifiants, adresses IP et données de pages ou événements et utiliser des témoins publicitaires. Notre code de formulaire ne doit pas envoyer le texte des demandes, courriels ou preuves à cette balise. Gérez vos choix dans le navigateur et Google My Ad Center; consultez les explications de Google. Le suivi publicitaire n’est pas nécessaire à l’envoi.

Nous conservons les dossiers seulement aussi longtemps que raisonnablement nécessaire pour la demande, la commande, la comptabilité légale ou la défense de droits. Les données devenues inutiles doivent être supprimées ou dépersonnalisées, sans promesse de stockage indéfini ni d’effacement immédiat automatique. L’accès est limité aux personnes et fournisseurs qui en ont besoin; des garanties raisonnables ne peuvent assurer une sécurité parfaite.

Vous pouvez nous contacter pour connaître nos pratiques, demander l’accès, une correction, un effacement applicable, retirer un consentement sous réserve des limites légales et contractuelles, ou porter plainte. Nous pouvons vérifier raisonnablement l’identité. Ne transmettez pas de document sensible dans le formulaire général. Le retrait de renseignements nécessaires peut empêcher la poursuite du travail, sans supprimer les droits impératifs ni les obligations de conservation. Nous répondons dans les délais légaux; vous pouvez aussi saisir l’autorité compétente.

Politique en vigueur le 27 octobre 2026. Une nouvelle finalité ou communication importante nécessite l’avis et le consentement appropriés lorsqu’exigés. Une mise à jour ne constitue pas une autorisation rétroactive. La commande écrite doit fournir l’identité et les coordonnées du fournisseur avant paiement. Pour toute question, veuillez nous contacter. Le consentement au marketing facultatif demeure distinct.
